suppress.notes: CVE-2008-7298 is about the 2008 Android stock browser's cookie handling, not androidx.browser (Custom Tabs).

CVE-2025-29903 is in JetBrains Runtime (the JDK fork), matched to Compose runtime by vendor name. CVE-2026-53914 is the Kotlin compiler's build-cache deserialization (fixed 2.4.20, we build with 2.4.21); CVE-2020-29582 was fixed in 1.4.21. Neither applies to stdlib/reflect at runtime.
Tasks.org to-do app CVEs, name-matched to kotlinx-coroutines-play-services ("Tasks" API).

scotty-minified.jar is a stripped, repackaged Guava subset inside firebase-crashlytics (latest). The temp-dir CVEs need local file access on a shared Unix host; the alloc one needs untrusted serialized input. Neither path exists in the app. Re-check when Crashlytics updates.
